Package chessgame.moves

Class Move

java.lang.Object
chessgame.moves.Move
public class Move extends Object
Represents a single chess move. This class encapsulates all the information needed to execute, record, and undo a move, including the pieces involved, special move flags (castling, promotion), and the algebraic notation.
